texts.title: The Cities Exhibition Guide

Notice that the market square sits at the intersection of two trade routes, which was never accidental. Move now into the industrial room, where the smell of coal has been reconstructed, controversially. Critics called it theatrical, although visitors consistently report that it's the exhibit they remember. The next section examines the sanitary revolution, without which no modern city could exist.
